settings.policy.title: Download quality policy
settings.policy.hint: Rules are evaluated top to bottom; the first match wins. Tasks hit by "skip" never touch the network.

settings.policy.rule.min_quality: Skip if target quality is below the threshold
settings.policy.rule.max_size: Downgrade if size exceeds the cap
settings.policy.rule.already_have: Skip if already in the library

aggregate.hint: Merge local favorites and platform playlists, flagging tracks available on multiple platforms.
aggregate.empty: Nothing to aggregate. Favorite a few tracks, or sign in to a platform first.
aggregate.noMatch: No tracks match the current filter.
aggregate.preferPrimary: Preferred copy of a cross-source duplicate
aggregate.failedHint: These sources failed to load and were counted as empty; check their sign-in state
aggregate.undecidableRowHint: This entry has no duration or artist, so it cannot be matched against the same track on other platforms. It is neither flagged as a duplicate nor dropped.
aggregate.undecidableSome: {count} tracks cannot be matched across sources (no duration or artist)
aggregate.undecidableHint: These titles collide with other platforms, but the platform gives no duration (or the entry has no artist), so sameness cannot be confirmed. They are neither flagged as duplicates nor discarded.

aggregate.truncatedHint: This build does not paginate these platforms' favorite-track APIs, so anything past the cap never enters this list. The favorites themselves are intact and still visible in the platform's own playlist.
